content: For the training data, we use Daily Mail news articles released by BIBREF9 . This dataset is composed of 219,506 articles covering a diverse range of topics including business, sports, travel, etc., and is claimed to be biased and sensational BIBREF5 . For manageability, we randomly subsample 5% of the text. The subsample has around 8.25 million tokens in total.
